title: Quinquecapsular
summary: QUINQUECAP'SULAR, adjective [Latin quinque, five, and capsula, a little chest.] In botany, having five capsules to a flower; as a quinquecapsular pericarp.

inlines.v: QUINQUECAP'SULAR, adjective [Latin quinque, five, and capsula, a little chest.] In botany, having five capsules to a flower; as a quinquecapsular pericarp.
